_comment: Tier-2 for skfem hyperelasticity#4, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Claim: C4 = lam C^-1 (x) C^-1 + 2(mu - lam lnJ) I4_sym_C^-1; dropping I4_sym_C^-1 for a scalar-multiplied identity I4 gives Newton rate ~0.5, linear instead of quadratic. Ran: total-Lagrangian PK2 Neo-Hookean, MeshTri().refined(3), ElementVector(ElementTriP1), 162 DOFs, mu=lam=1, residual int S:dE(v), tangent int dE(v):C4:dE(du) + int S:grad(du)^T grad(v), at 2% and 30% right-edge stretch. Printed: exact tangent converges in 3 and 4 iterations with the ratio collapsing (9.7e-05 then 6.4e-08); the dropped-I4sym tangent needs 8 and 33 iterations at a CONSTANT ratio, i.e. exactly linear. THE ~0.5 NUMBER IS NOT A CONSTANT: the measured asymptotic factor is 0.051 at 2% stretch and 0.436 at 30%, so it tracks the strain level and cannot be used as a fixed threshold. The inexact tangent NEVER diverges, never NaNs, emits no warning, and lands on the same displacement to 1.8e-13 / 3.3e-14 relative -- the cost is iterations, not correctness.
